messages:
alina: quick FYI, I ran a PTQ pass on rerank-3b for jp tasks. Aggregate ndcg unchanged but jp mrr down ~5%. Anyone seen locale-specific ptq deltas?

rafael: do you have a per-slice breakdown (short vs long queries, cache state)?

alina: ran with slices cache_state,query_len. cold mrr delta -0.02, warm mrr delta -0.08. so warm cache amplifies it.

chen: warm amplification suggests kv-cache path. Did runtime kernels or preproc change recently?

morgan: ops pushed fast-matmul for cached path last week to save latency. Could be numerical differences.

alina: toggled kernel to deterministic matmul on a 1k shard: warm mrr improved to -0.01. Also toggled strip_code preproc off and that recovered another ~0.02.

rafael: so interaction of preproc + ptq + fast kernel. small tokenization boundary shifts in japanese = top1 swaps.

chen: can you paste a minimal example pair?

alina: example: query "\u65b0\u5bbf \u30ab\u30ec\u30fc"; fp32 top1 doc contains exact phrase (score 3.12) but ptq picks broader doc (fp32 A=3.12 B=3.07; ptq A=3.01 B=3.09).

morgan: tiny score shifts cascade because subsequent tokens rely on kv cache. actionables: 1) alina re-run per-channel ptq + deterministic kernel and post top1 swap list (limit 50) by EOD; 2) chen add kv-key reproducibility unit tests for common jp token patterns; 3) ops gate fast-matmul behind jp canary.

eval-bot: eval finished for rerank-3b-ptq (2024-06-10T15:20Z): ndcg@10 delta -0.002, mrr delta -0.047 on jp_passage. warm-cache swap rate 6.8% (68/1000).

alina: thanks. holding the rollout until we confirm per-channel ptq + kernel combo. Will open PR to make strip_code opt-in for ja.
